findings.title: Failed eager initialization does not clean up partial startup
findings.body: This call can run `Lifecycle.Init` successfully and then fail during search or watcher initialization. The constructor returns `nil` without calling `s.cancel` or `Lifecycle.Stop`, and the caller cannot access the partially initialized server to stop it. Any resources or goroutines started by the lifecycle hooks can therefore survive a failed server construction. Clean up the partially initialized server before returning the error.

findings.title: Eager initialization starts a watcher that panics when its event stream closes
findings.body: With search configured, `s.Init` starts a goroutine in `search.init` that reads `WatchWriteEvents` using a background context and passes each received value to `handleEvent` without checking whether the channel is closed. The SQL backend closes that channel when stopped, so the goroutine receives `nil` and `handleEvent` dereferences it, causing an unrecovered panic. Eager initialization starts this watcher even before the server handles a request; stop the consumer on context cancellation or channel closure.
